limits: Pseudocode is decompiler output, not original buildable C/C++.
Expanded boundaries are caller assertions with documented heuristic provenance.
Call candidates are textual direct FUN_* references in decompiled bodies; indirect calls, external symbol calls and optimized flows can be absent. They are not a verified complete call graph.
Candidate names from broad table scanning remain unconfirmed; explicitly bounded dispatch tables are tagged separately.
Function names/types and source attribution can be inferred or incomplete.
